_source.body: A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences. As a Data Engineer specializing in Google's data platforms, you will design, build, and maintain data engineering solutions on Google's Cloud ecosystem. This role requires expertise in utilizing various Google services for batch and real-time data pipelines, data migration, and data layer design. Your primary responsibilities will include: • Design Data Pipelines: Design and develop batch and real-time data pipelines for Data Warehouse and Datalake using Google services such as DataProc, DataFlow, PubSub, BigQuery, and Big Table. • Develop Data Engineering Solutions: Utilize Google Cloud Storage, BigTable, BigQuery DataProc with Spark and Hadoop, and Google DataFlow with Apache Beam or Python to build and maintain data engineering solutions. • Manage Data Platforms: Schedule and manage the data platform using Google Cloud Scheduler and Cloud Composer (Airflow), ensuring efficient data pipeline operations. • Implement Data Migration: Develop and implement data migration solutions using Google services, ensuring seamless data transfer between systems. • Optimize Data Layer: Design and optimize the data layer using Google services such as BigQuery, Big Table, and Cloud Spanner, ensuring efficient data storage and retrieval. • Google Cloud Ecosystem Expertise: Exposure to designing, building, and maintaining data engineering solutions on Google's Cloud ecosystem, including services such as Google DataProc, DataFlow, PubSub, BigQuery, Big Table, Cloud Spanner, CloudSQL, and AlloyDB. • Data Pipeline Development Experience: Exposure to developing and managing batch and real-time data pipelines for Data Warehouse and Datalake using Google services and open-source technologies like Apache Airflow, dbt, Spark/Python, or Spark/Scala. • Google Cloud Services Proficiency: Experience working with Google Cloud Storage, BigTable, BigQuery DataProc with Spark and Hadoop, and Google DataFlow with Apache Beam or Python to build and maintain data engineering solutions. • Data Platform Management Knowledge: Exposure to scheduling and managing the data platform using Google Cloud Scheduler and Cloud Composer (Airflow) for efficient data pipeline operations. • Data Layer Design Understanding: Experience working with data layer design using Google services such as BigQuery, Big Table, and Cloud Spanner for efficient data storage and retrieval. • Open Source Technologies: Exposure to utilizing open-source technologies like Apache Airflow, dbt, Spark/Python, or Spark/Scala for developing and managing batch and real-time data pipelines. • Data Migration Solutions: Experience working with Google services to develop and implement data migration solutions, ensuring seamless data transfer between systems. • Cloud Composer Expertise: Exposure to using Cloud Composer (Airflow) for scheduling and managing the data platform, ensuring efficient data pipeline operations. From high-resiliency mainframes and hybrid cloud platforms to networking, automation, and site reliability. Our teams ensure the performance, security, and scalability that clients and industries depend on every day. Working in Infrastructure & Technology means tackling complex challenges with curiosity and collaboration. You'll work with diverse technologies and colleagues worldwide to deliver resilient, future-ready solutions that power innovation. With continuous learning, career growth, and a supportive culture, IBM provides the opportunities to build expertise and shape the infrastructure that drives progress. As a Software Development Manager for Cognitive Systems, you will design, develop, test, and deliver offerings using the latest technologies, while aligning employees' work with IBM's strategy and goals. You will lead or participate in organization planning, providing leadership and support to ensure business objectives are met. Your primary responsibilities will include: • Lead Offering Development: Design, develop, test, and deliver Cognitive Systems offerings using the latest technologies, ensuring alignment with IBM's strategy and goals. • Manage Employee Resources: Assign individuals and collaborate with other leaders to allocate employee resources, meeting IBM, project/account, and individual development needs. • Experience in advising and coaching employees to help them develop their skills and capabilities, enhancing IBM's climate and business results. • Advanced Technology Knowledge: Deep understanding of the latest technologies used in Cognitive Systems, including their applications and limitations, to design and deliver innovative offerings. • Strategic Planning Expertise: Experience with strategic planning and resource allocation to drive business results and meet client satisfaction, productivity, and financial goals. • Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven ability to lead and collaborate with cross-functional teams to promote IBM's diversity and inclusive leadership, and drive business success. _source.body: About the Team The Connect UI team builds the experiences Confluent Cloud customers use to bring data into and out of Kafka. That covers browsing and setting up fully managed and custom connectors, troubleshooting connector failures with AI assistance, and visualizing how connectors are performing. Connectors are where customers' real-time data enters the platform, so the quality of what we build directly affects how quickly customers get up and running About the Role We are looking for a Frontend Software Engineer who's excited to help build engaging, intuitive products for managing and visualizing large-scale, real-time data streams. Data flow is central to how companies operate, and we aim to make that experience simple and attractive. Working with mentorship from senior engineers, you will help develop features across the Connect experience in Confluent Cloud and steadily grow into an owner of parts of the product.  Our Cloud UI is built with React and TypeScript on our own design system, and connects to multiple REST and GraphQL APIs. We test with Jest and React Testing Library (unit) and Playwright (end-to-end). We deploy to production daily and can test every commit, including PRs, before it goes live. Feature flags let us release independently of backend teams, and bots keep our dependencies up to date.  AI-assisted development tools are part of our everyday engineering workflow. As a Frontend Software Engineer, you will help build client-side features for data-intensive products, working closely with senior engineers, designers and product managers. You will: Help develop new features from user requirements and designs, taking on well-defined tasks within larger features, delivering them on time, refining them based on feedback, and growing the scope you own over time. Build UI components and interactions to the design specifications using our design system, and integrate with backend APIs, working with backend engineers to understand API contracts and handle loading, error and empty states well. Write clean, readable code with unit and end-to-end tests, and write short design notes for your tasks for peer review. Take part in code reviews, both receiving and giving feedback. Help investigate and fix bugs and production issues, starting by shadowing the on-call rotation. Share your progress clearly in standups and project updates, and raise blockers early. Learn Confluent's engineering practices, including release, monitoring and feature flag processes, and how our product works end to end. Experience with 0.6 –1 year of professional experience and a strong foundation in data structures, algorithms and problem-solving Strong JavaScript fundamentals, including asynchronous programming (promises, async/await), closures and the DOM, plus solid HTML and CSS skills, including responsive layouts A good understanding of React (components, props, state, hooks, and how components re-render) and a basic understanding of frontend architecture: structuring components, managing state, and separating data fetching from UI Experience building and bundling a frontend project with Webpack or a similar tool such as Vite, including an understanding of modules, loaders and code splitting Comfort debugging with browser developer tools, and familiarity with Git and a pull-request-based workflow Curiosity, eagerness to learn and openness to feedback, with good communication and collaboration skills and a team-first mindset Awareness of web accessibility and web performance (for example, bundle size and Core Web Vitals) Experience with data visualization or charting libraries Exposure to AI-powered workflows, agentic AI or LLM-based applications Internships, open-source contributions, hackathons or personal projects you've built and shipped Interest in data streaming, Kafka or distributed systems (no prior experience needed) India Software Engineering Remote Professional Bangalore, IN Bangalore (0063) IBM India Private Limited Automation Business Requirements Design Refining Scripting Software Software Development Testing Financial and Operational Combined Uniform Single Reporting Solution implementation Process Improvement Business Requirements analysis Scripting languages Efficiency Automation Frameworks Confluent
